segments.name: Community and Commercial Banking
products: consumer, real estate and commercial loans
segments.description: Provides banking services, including loans and deposit products, to consumer, business and corporate customers across the Company's six-state footprint.
segments.evidence: The Company is organized with community and commercial banking groups.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Holds the wealth group, which provides trust, investment and insurance services and does not meet quantitative thresholds for separate reporting.
segments.evidence: The Company also considers its wealth group, which provides trust and investment services, as well as insurance services, to be operating segments.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns net interest income from loans and deposits and noninterest income from fees on services such as trust, brokerage and treasury management, paid by individual and business customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The CODM analyzes on the spread between interest revenue and interest expense (net interest income) to assess performance and to allocate operating and capital resources.
